Group rides in Washington, DC

5 recurring group rides around Washington, DC: 4 social, 3 road. 3 roll on weeknights, 2 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with DC Queer Bike Rides in Washington — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Sunday No-Drop Group Bike Rides (DC Tri Club) runs no-drop, 12–17 mph.
